+    smem: Int32, mbar: Int32, peer: Int32, value: Uint32, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> None:
+    """Store a word at ``smem`` of cluster CTA ``peer`` (the same offset as a
+    local address), completing 4 bytes on the peer's ``mbar``."""
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [_v(Int32(v), loc, ip) for v in (smem, mbar, peer)]
+        + [_v(Uint32(value), loc, ip)],
+        "{\n\t.reg .b32 ra, rb;\n\tmapa.shared::cluster.u32 ra, $0, $2;\n\t"
+        "mapa.shared::cluster.u32 rb, $1, $2;\n\t"
+        "st.async.shared::cluster.mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes.b32 "
+        "[ra], $3, [rb];\n\t}",
+        "r,r,r,r",
+        True,
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def bulk_copy_to_peer(
+    dest: Int32,
+    source: Int32,
+    size: Int32,
+    mbar: Int32,
+    peer: Int32,
+    *,
+    loc=None,
+    ip=None,
+) -> None:
+    """Bulk-copy ``size`` bytes of this CTA's shared memory at ``source`` to
+    ``dest`` of cluster CTA ``peer`` (the same offset as a local address),
+    completing on the peer's ``mbar``."""
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [_v(Int32(v), loc, ip) for v in (dest, source, size, mbar, peer)],
+        "{\n\t.reg .b32 rd, rb;\n\tmapa.shared::cluster.u32 rd, $0, $4;\n\t"
+        "mapa.shared::cluster.u32 rb, $3, $4;\n\t"
+        "cp.async.bulk.shared::cluster.shared::cta.mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes "
+        "[rd], [$1], $2, [rb];\n\t}",
+        "r,r,r,r,r",
+        True,
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )

+class SparseMlaDecodeCute:
+    """The sparse-MLA decode (module docstring) of tokens whose sparse sets
+    are at most ``chunks`` x 128 columns wide; ``has_sinks``: add each head's
+    attention sink to the softmax denominator."""
+
+    def __init__(self, chunks: int, has_sinks: bool) -> None:
+        assert 1 <= chunks <= MAX_CHUNKS
+        self.n = chunks
+        self.has_sinks = has_sinks
+        # Received partial blocks a CTA owns at most (block j -> CTA j % n).
+        self.slots = (4 + chunks - 1) // chunks
+        # Partials go out from the KV tile's upper half, part 4 + j for block j,
+        # and arrive in its lower half (at most 4 parts: slots x (n - 1) <= 4).
+        self.stage_part = 4
+        assert self.slots * (chunks - 1) <= self.stage_part
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        q_ptr: Int64,
+        q_stride: Int32,
+        swa_ptr: Int64,
+        swa_stride: Int32,
+        comp_ptr: Int64,
+        comp_stride: Int32,
+        idx_ptr: Int64,
+        idx_stride: Int32,
+        idx_cols: Int32,
+        lens_ptr: Int64,
+        sinks_ptr: Int64,
+        out_ptr: Int64,
+        out_stride: Int32,
+        scale_log2: Float32,
+        out_scale: Float32,
+        tokens: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """Launch on ``stream``: one cluster of ``n`` CTAs a token. Pointers
+        are addresses; strides are in elements (bytes for the FP8 query and
+        pools, BF16 elements for ``out``); ``scale_log2`` is
+        ``bmm1_scale * log2(e)``."""
+        self.kernel(
+            q_ptr,
+            q_stride,
+            swa_ptr,
+            swa_stride,
+            comp_ptr,
+            comp_stride,
+            idx_ptr,
+            idx_stride,
+            idx_cols,
+            lens_ptr,
+            sinks_ptr,
+            out_ptr,
+            out_stride,
+            scale_log2,
+            out_scale,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(self.n, tokens, 1),
+            block=(THREADS, 1, 1),
+            cluster=(self.n, 1, 1),
+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=True,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        q_ptr: Int64,
+        q_stride: Int32,
+        swa_ptr: Int64,
+        swa_stride: Int32,
+        comp_ptr: Int64,
+        comp_stride: Int32,
+        idx_ptr: Int64,
+        idx_stride: Int32,
+        idx_cols: Int32,
+        lens_ptr: Int64,
+        sinks_ptr: Int64,
+        out_ptr: Int64,
+        out_stride: Int32,
+        scale_log2: Float32,
+        out_scale: Float32,
+    ):
+        n = self.n
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        chunk, token, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        warp = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(tid // 32)
+        lane = tid % 32
+        # Softmax groups: 8 threads a head, 16 rows each.
+        head = tid // 8
+        part = tid % 8
+        neg_inf = Float32(-math.inf)
+
+        smem = utils.SmemAllocator()
+        kv = smem.allocate_array(cutlass.Uint8, 4 * BLOCK_BYTES, byte_alignment=1024)
+        sq = smem.allocate_array(cutlass.Uint8, 4 * Q_BLOCK_BYTES, byte_alignment=1024)
+        sp = smem.allocate_array(cutlass.Uint8, HEADS * 128, byte_alignment=1024)
+        s_addr = smem.allocate_tensor(Int64, cute.make_layout(ROWS), 16)
+        # Per head: chunk max, chunk sum, merge factor, sink (base 2).
+        s_stat = smem.allocate_tensor(Float32, cute.make_layout((HEADS, 4)), 16)
+        # Per head and chunk of the cluster: max (rows 0-15), sum (rows 16-31).
+        s_ml = smem.allocate_tensor(Float32, cute.make_layout((2 * HEADS, n)), 16)
+        mbars = smem.allocate_array(Int64, 3, byte_alignment=8)
+        taddr = smem.allocate_array(Int32, 4, byte_alignment=16)
+        mbar_mma = mbars
+        mbar_ml = mbars + 1
+        mbar_o = mbars + 2
+        if tid == 0:
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init(mbar_mma, 1)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init(mbar_ml, 1)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init(mbar_o, 1)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init_fence()
+        # The sinks are weights: read them before the grid wait.
+        if tid < HEADS:
+            sink = neg_inf
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.has_sinks):
+                sink = ld_global_f32(sinks_ptr + Int64(tid * 4)) * Float32(LOG2E)
+            s_stat[tid, 3] = sink
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(n > 1):
+            # Peers must see these barriers initialized before their st.async.
+            cute.arch.cluster_arrive_relaxed()
+        # Indices, query and KV all come from earlier kernels.
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        if warp == 0:
+            cute.arch.alloc_tmem(TMEM_COLS, taddr)
+            cute.arch.relinquish_tmem_alloc_permit()
+
+        # 1. This thread's KV row: its address, or 0 when masked. The length
+        # and the index load independently.
+        col = chunk * ROWS + tid
+        length = ld_global_s32(lens_ptr + Int64(token) * 4)
+        index = ld_global_s32(
+            idx_ptr
+            + (Int64(token) * Int64(idx_stride) + Int64(cute.min(col, idx_cols - 1)))
+            * 4
+        )
+        address = Int64(0)
+        if (col < length) & (col < idx_cols):  # noqa: SIM102
+            if index >= 0:
+                if chunk == 0:
+                    address = swa_ptr + Int64(index) * Int64(swa_stride)
+                else:
+                    address = comp_ptr + Int64(index) * Int64(comp_stride)
+        masked = address == Int64(0)
+        s_addr[tid] = address
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+        # Gather in four cp.async groups, one per 128-byte K block of the rows (with
+        # the query's K block): in a group a warp copies 4 rows a step, 8 lanes a
+        # row, each 16-byte piece to its 128B-swizzled slot. The MMAs of a K block
+        # start as soon as its group has landed, while the later groups load.
+        kv_base = kv.toint()
+        sq_base = sq.toint()
+        sp_base = sp.toint()
+        q_row = q_ptr + Int64(token) * Int64(q_stride)
+        q_head = tid // 8
+        q_piece = tid % 8
+        piece = lane % 8
+        for kb in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            cp_async_16(
+                sq_base
+                + kb * Q_BLOCK_BYTES
+                + q_head * 128
+                + ((q_piece ^ (q_head % 8)) * 16),
+                q_row + Int64(q_head * HEAD_DIM + kb * 128 + q_piece * 16),
+            )
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROWS // 16):
+                row = (i * 4 + warp) * 4 + lane // 8
+                source = s_addr[row]
+                dest = (
+                    kv_base + kb * BLOCK_BYTES + row * 128 + ((piece ^ (row % 8)) * 16)
+                )
+                if source != 0:
+                    cp_async_16(dest, source + Int64(kb * 128 + piece * 16))
+                else:
+                    st_shared_zero16(dest)
+            cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+
+        # 2. S^T = KV x Q^T, 4 MMAs of K = 32 a K block.
+        tmem = cute.make_tensor(taddr, cute.make_layout(1))[0]
+        for kb in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            cute.arch.cp_async_wait_group(3 - kb)
+            cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            if warp == 0:
+                _tcgen05.fence_after_thread_sync()
+                for k4 in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    adesc = Uint64(SDESC_K) | Uint64(
+                        (kv_base + kb * BLOCK_BYTES + k4 * 32) >> 4
+                    )
+                    bdesc = Uint64(SDESC_K) | Uint64(
+                        (sq_base + kb * Q_BLOCK_BYTES + k4 * 32) >> 4
+                    )
+                    with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                        mma_f8(
+                            tmem,
+                            adesc,
+                            bdesc,
+                            Uint32(IDESC_QK),
+                            Int32(1 if kb + k4 > 0 else 0),
+                        )
+                if cutlass.const_expr(kb == 3):
+                    _tcgen05.commit(mbar_mma)
+                    with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(mbar_mma, 0)
+        _tcgen05.fence_after_thread_sync()
+
+        # 3. Chunk softmax. Each thread's TMEM lane is one KV row; the scores are
+        # transposed through the (now free) query tile so that 8 threads reduce
+        # one head's 128 rows.
+        s = cute.make_rmem_tensor((HEADS,), Float32)
+        s.store(_tcgen05.ld(warp * 32, tmem, "32x32b", HEADS))
+        _tcgen05.wait_ld()
+        s_t = cute.make_tensor(
+            cute.recast_ptr(sq, dtype=Float32),
+            cute.make_layout((HEADS, ROWS), stride=(ROWS, 1)),
+        )
+        for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(HEADS):
+            value = s[h] * scale_log2
+            if masked:
+                value = neg_inf
+            s_t[h, tid] = value
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        vals = cute.make_rmem_tensor((16,), Float32)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+            vals[i] = s_t[head, part * 16 + i]
+        peak = vals[0]
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, 16):
+            peak = cute.arch.fmax(peak, vals[i])
+        peak = cute.arch.warp_reduction_max(peak, threads_in_group=8)
+        base = peak
+        if peak == neg_inf:
+            base = Float32(0.0)
+        total = Float32(0.0)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+            vals[i] = cute.math.exp2(vals[i] - base, fastmath=True)
+            total = total + vals[i]
+        total = cute.arch.warp_reduction_sum(total, threads_in_group=8)
+        # P^T as the K-major B operand: head h's 128 rows are one 128-byte row,
+        # this thread's 16 at its swizzled 16-byte slot.
+        scale_p = Float32(P_SCALE)
+        st_shared_v4(
+            sp_base + head * 128 + ((part ^ (head % 8)) * 16),
+            pack_e4m3x4(
+                vals[0] * scale_p,
+                vals[1] * scale_p,
+                vals[2] * scale_p,
+                vals[3] * scale_p,
+            ),
+            pack_e4m3x4(
+                vals[4] * scale_p,
+                vals[5] * scale_p,
+                vals[6] * scale_p,
+                vals[7] * scale_p,
+            ),
+            pack_e4m3x4(
+                vals[8] * scale_p,
+                vals[9] * scale_p,
+                vals[10] * scale_p,
+                vals[11] * scale_p,
+            ),
+            pack_e4m3x4(
+                vals[12] * scale_p,
+                vals[13] * scale_p,
+                vals[14] * scale_p,
+                vals[15] * scale_p,
+            ),
+        )
+        if part == 0:
+            s_stat[head, 0] = peak
+            s_stat[head, 1] = total
+        cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+        # 4. O^T = V^T x P^T, four MMAs of 128 head dims (K = 128 rows each);
+        # the statistics exchange and the merge factors overlap them.
+        if warp == 0:
+            _tcgen05.fence_after_thread_sync()

+                            adesc,
+                            bdesc,
+                            Uint32(IDESC_PV),
+                            Int32(1 if kk > 0 else 0),

+            s_ml_base = s_ml.iterator.toint()
+            cute.arch.cluster_wait()
+            if tid == 0:
+                mbar_ops.arrive_expect_tx(mbar_ml, n * 2 * HEADS * 4)
+            if tid < 2 * HEADS:

+                for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(n):

+                        s_ml_base + (chunk * 2 * HEADS + tid) * 4,
+                        mbar_ml_addr,
+                        Int32(peer),
+                        recast_val(stat, Uint32),
+                    )
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(mbar_ml, 0)
+        # 5. Merge factors, one thread a head: exp2(m_c - M) / L, L with the sink.
+        if tid < HEADS:
+            own = s_stat[tid, 0]
+            sink = s_stat[tid, 3]
+            top = sink
+            denom = Float32(0.0)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(n > 1):
+                for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(n):
+                    top = cute.arch.fmax(top, s_ml[tid, c])
+                for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(n):

+                        denom = (
+                            denom
+                            + cute.math.exp2(peak_c - top, fastmath=True)
+                            * s_ml[HEADS + tid, c]
+                        )
+            else:
+                top = cute.arch.fmax(top, own)
+                if own != neg_inf:
+                    denom = cute.math.exp2(own - top, fastmath=True) * s_stat[tid, 1]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.has_sinks):
+                denom = denom + cute.math.exp2(sink - top, fastmath=True)
+            f = Float32(0.0)
+            if own != neg_inf:  # noqa: SIM102
+                if denom > Float32(0.0):
+                    f = (
+                        cute.math.exp2(own - top, fastmath=True)
+                        / denom
+                        * out_scale
+                        * Float32(1.0 / P_SCALE)
+                    )
+            s_stat[tid, 2] = f
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(mbar_mma, 1)
+        _tcgen05.fence_after_thread_sync()
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(n > 1):
+            # This CTA's MMAs are done: peers may now write into its tile.
+            cute.arch.cluster_arrive()
+        o = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4 * HEADS,), Float32)
+        o.store(_tcgen05.ld(warp * 32, tmem + HEADS, "32x32b", 4 * HEADS))
+        _tcgen05.wait_ld()
+        factor = cute.make_rmem_tensor((HEADS,), Float32)
+        for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(HEADS):
+            factor[h] = s_stat[h, 2]
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(HEADS):
+                o[j * HEADS + h] = o[j * HEADS + h] * factor[h]
+        # Thread tid holds head dim (128 j + tid) of every head.
+        out_row = out_ptr + Int64(token) * Int64(out_stride) * 2
+        if cutlass.const_expr(n == 1):
+            # Stage [block][head][dim] BF16 in the tile, then 16-byte stores.
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(HEADS):
+                    st_shared_bf16(
+                        kv_base + ((j * HEADS + h) * 128 + tid) * 2, o[j * HEADS + h]
+                    )
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4 * HEADS * 16 // THREADS):
+                piece = k * THREADS + tid
+                rowid = piece // 16
+                d16 = piece % 16
+                blk = rowid // HEADS
+                h = rowid % HEADS
+                copy16_shared_to_global(
+                    kv_base + piece * 16,
+                    out_row + Int64((h * HEAD_DIM + blk * 128 + d16 * 8) * 2),
+                )
+        else:
+            mbar_o_addr = mbar_o.toint()
+            owned = Int32(0)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                if chunk == j % n:
+                    owned = owned + 1
+            # The tile as 8 FP32 parts of [head][row]: head-major, so a warp's
+            # 32 rows of one head are 32 consecutive words (no bank conflicts
+            # on either side).
+            parts = cute.make_tensor(
+                cute.recast_ptr(kv, dtype=Float32),
+                cute.make_layout((HEADS, ROWS, 8), stride=(ROWS, 1, ROWS * HEADS)),
+            )
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                if chunk != j % n:
+                    for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(HEADS):
+                        parts[h, tid, self.stage_part + j] = o[j * HEADS + h]
+            cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            if tid == 0:  # noqa: SIM102
+                if owned > 0:
+                    mbar_ops.arrive_expect_tx(mbar_o, owned * (n - 1) * PART_BYTES)
+            # Every peer's MMAs are done, so its tile's lower half can take
+            # partials: sender s of block j lands in part (j // n) (n - 1) + s,
+            # the senders numbered without the owner.
+            cute.arch.cluster_wait()
+            if tid == 0:
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    owner = j % n
+                    if chunk != owner:
+                        sender = chunk
+                        if chunk > owner:
+                            sender = chunk - 1
+                        bulk_copy_to_peer(
+                            kv_base + ((j // n) * (n - 1) + sender) * PART_BYTES,
+                            kv_base + (self.stage_part + j) * PART_BYTES,
+                            Int32(PART_BYTES),
+                            mbar_o_addr,
+                            Int32(owner),
+                        )
+            if owned > 0:
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(mbar_o, 0)
+                # Owned block j (slot j // n): the sum, BF16 [slot][head][dim]
+                # in the query tile, then 16-byte stores.
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    if chunk == j % n:
+                        for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(HEADS):
+                            acc = o[j * HEADS + h]
+                            for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(n - 1):
+                                acc = acc + parts[h, tid, (j // n) * (n - 1) + c]
+                            st_shared_bf16(
+                                sq_base + (((j // n) * HEADS + h) * 128 + tid) * 2, acc
+                            )
+                cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                for slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.slots):
+                    if chunk + slot * n < 4:
+                        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(HEADS * 16 // THREADS):
+                            piece = k * THREADS + tid
+                            h = piece // 16
+                            d16 = piece % 16
+                            copy16_shared_to_global(
+                                sq_base + (slot * HEADS * 128) * 2 + piece * 16,
+                                out_row
+                                + Int64(
+                                    (h * HEAD_DIM + (chunk + slot * n) * 128 + d16 * 8)
+                                    * 2
+                                ),
+                            )
+            # The bulk copies read this CTA's staged partials asynchronously:
+            # stay resident until every owner has received (its arrive follows
+            # its mbarrier wait).
+            cute.arch.cluster_arrive_relaxed()
+            cute.arch.cluster_wait()
+        _tcgen05.fence_before_thread_sync()
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        if warp == 0:
+            _tcgen05.fence_after_thread_sync()
+            cute.arch.dealloc_tmem(
+                cute.make_ptr(Float32, tmem, cute.AddressSpace.tmem), TMEM_COLS
+            )
+

+@cache
+def _kernel(device_index: int, chunks: int, has_sinks: bool):
+    """``SparseMlaDecodeCute`` compiled for a device, chunk count and sinks."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(
+            SparseMlaDecodeCute(chunks, has_sinks),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int32(1),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Float32(0),
+            Float32(0),
+            Int32(1),
+            make_fake_stream(),
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def _max_tokens(device_index: int, chunks: int) -> int:
+    """Tokens whose clusters are all resident at once: ``CTAS_PER_SM`` times
+    the resident clusters of ``chunks`` CTAs at one CTA an SM."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        clusters = cutlass.utils.HardwareInfo(device_index).get_max_active_clusters(
+            chunks
+        )
+    return CTAS_PER_SM * clusters
+
+
+def precompile(device_index: int, has_sinks: bool) -> None:
+    """Compile the kernels of DeepSeek-V4's two widths (128 sliding-window
+    columns alone, and 640) and count the resident clusters, outside any CUDA
+    graph capture; other widths compile at their first launch.
+
+    Args:
+        device_index: The CUDA device to compile for.
+        has_sinks: Whether the layers add attention sinks.
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""A decode step's token embedding from a full copy of the table on every rank.
+
+Under tensor parallelism vLLM shards the token embedding table by vocabulary
+(``VocabParallelEmbedding``): each rank looks up the tokens its shard holds,
+writes zeros for the others, and an all-reduce sums the ranks' rows. The
+DeepSeek-V4.1 backbone then copies the embedding into its ``hc_mult``
+hyper-connection streams ([n, H] -> [n, hc, H]) at the first layer. At a
+few rows both are fixed costs on the critical path of every step.
+
+``ReplicatedEmbedding`` keeps a full copy of the table on every rank: the
+ranks broadcast their shards into it once, when the decode executor is built
+(1.32 GB a GPU for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash), which is before the KV cache is
+sized, so the memory profile counts it. A captured decode step then looks its
+tokens up in one launch of ``StreamEmbedding`` that writes the embedding (for
+the target's first layer, whose pre-mix reads it) and its streams, and needs
+no collective. A token outside the vocabulary gets zeros, as the sharded
+lookup's sum gives it, so the result equals the all-reduced embedding (up to
+the sign of a zero, which the sum makes positive).
+
+The copy serves the table as it was when the executor was built. Loading
+weights again rewrites the shards in place but not the copy, so a deployment
+that updates weights at runtime must not use the specialized decode.
+"""
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Int32
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_ptr
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod,
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,
+)
+from vllm.models.common.ops.moe_tail_fusion.primitives import current_cu_stream
+
+THREADS = 256
+VECTOR_BYTES = 16
+MAX_CTAS = 1024
+
+
+class StreamEmbedding:
+    """Rows of a ``[vocab, H]`` BF16 table into an ``[n, H]`` embedding and
+    its ``[n, hc_mult, H]`` streams, by 16-byte vectors; a token outside
+    ``[0, vocab)`` gets zeros."""
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden: int, hc_mult: int) -> None:
+        assert hidden * 2 % VECTOR_BYTES == 0
+        self.row_vectors = hidden * 2 // VECTOR_BYTES
+        self.hc_mult = hc_mult
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        ids_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        table_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        embedding_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        streams_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        vocab: Int32,
+        num_ctas: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """Every tensor as int32 words; a row's vector ``v`` is the column
+        ``v`` of four words."""
+        row_vectors = self.row_vectors
+        self.kernel(
+            cute.make_tensor(ids_ptr, cute.make_layout((rows,))),
+            cute.make_tensor(table_ptr, cute.make_layout((4, row_vectors, vocab))),
+            cute.make_tensor(embedding_ptr, cute.make_layout((4, row_vectors, rows))),
+            cute.make_tensor(
+                streams_ptr, cute.make_layout((4, row_vectors, self.hc_mult, rows))
+            ),
+            rows,
+            vocab,
+            num_ctas,
+        ).launch(grid=(num_ctas, 1, 1), block=[THREADS, 1, 1], stream=stream)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        ids: cute.Tensor,
+        table: cute.Tensor,
+        embedding: cute.Tensor,
+        streams: cute.Tensor,
+        rows: Int32,
+        vocab: Int32,
+        num_ctas: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Thread t of CTA c takes the (row, vector) items c * THREADS + t,
+        then every num_ctas * THREADS after it."""
+        thread, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        cta, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        vector = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(), Int32, num_bits_per_copy=128
+        )
+        words = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4,), Int32)
+        row_vectors = self.row_vectors
+        for item in cutlass.range(
+            cta * THREADS + thread, rows * row_vectors, num_ctas * THREADS, unroll=1
+        ):
+            row = item // row_vectors
+            v = item - row * row_vectors
+            token = ids[row]
+            words.fill(0)
+            if token >= 0:  # noqa: SIM102
+                if token < vocab:
+                    cute.copy(vector, table[None, v, token], words)
+            cute.copy(vector, words, embedding[None, v, row])
+            for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.hc_mult):
+                cute.copy(vector, words, streams[None, v, c, row])
+
+
+def _pointer(address: int, align: int = VECTOR_BYTES):
+    """A CuTe DSL global-memory pointer to int32 words."""
+    return make_ptr(Int32, address, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=align)
+
+
+@cache
+def _kernel(device_index: int, hidden: int, hc_mult: int):
+    """``StreamEmbedding`` compiled for a device."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(
+            StreamEmbedding(hidden, hc_mult),
+            _pointer(16, 4),
+            _pointer(16),
+            _pointer(16),
+            _pointer(16),
+            Int32(1),
+            Int32(1),
+            Int32(1),
+            make_fake_stream(),
+        )
+
+
+def embed_streams(
+    ids: torch.Tensor,
+    table: torch.Tensor,
+    embedding: torch.Tensor,
+    streams: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Write ``table``'s rows of ``ids`` (int32 ``[n]``) into ``embedding``
+    (``[n, H]``) and ``streams`` (``[n, hc, H]``), on the current stream;
+    zeros for an id outside the table."""
+    rows, hc_mult, hidden = streams.shape
+    assert ids.dtype == torch.int32 and ids.shape == (rows,) and ids.is_contiguous()
+    assert table.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and table.shape[1] == hidden
+    assert table.is_contiguous() and streams.is_contiguous()
+    assert streams.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert embedding.shape == (rows, hidden) and embedding.is_contiguous()
+    assert embedding.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    if rows == 0:
+        return
+    items = rows * (hidden * 2 // VECTOR_BYTES)
+    num_ctas = min((items + THREADS - 1) // THREADS, MAX_CTAS)
+    _kernel(table.device.index, hidden, hc_mult)(
+        _pointer(ids.data_ptr(), 4),
+        _pointer(table.data_ptr()),
+        _pointer(embedding.data_ptr()),
+        _pointer(streams.data_ptr()),
+        Int32(rows),
+        Int32(table.shape[0]),
+        Int32(num_ctas),
+        current_cu_stream(),
+    )
+
+
+class ReplicatedEmbedding:
+    """A full copy of a vocabulary-parallel embedding table on every TP rank,
+    and a decode step's lookup from it."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(cls, embed: nn.Module, hc_mult: int) -> "ReplicatedEmbedding | None":
+        """The copy of ``embed``'s table, or None when ``embed`` is not the
+        plain sharded BF16 lookup this replaces. The decision reads only the
+        configuration, which every TP rank shares; building the copy is
+        collective."""
+        if not isinstance(embed, VocabParallelEmbedding):
+            return None
+        weight = embed.weight
+        indices = embed.shard_indices
+        if (
+            embed.tp_size == 1
+            or not embed.reduce_results
+            or embed.parallel_group is not None
+            or not isinstance(embed.quant_method, UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod)
+            or weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or weight.dim() != 2
+            or not weight.is_contiguous()
+            or weight.shape[1] * 2 % VECTOR_BYTES
+            or indices.added_vocab_end_index != indices.added_vocab_start_index
+        ):
+            return None
+        return cls(embed, hc_mult)
+
+    def __init__(self, embed: VocabParallelEmbedding, hc_mult: int) -> None:
+        group = get_tp_group()
+        weight = embed.weight.data
+        indices = embed.shard_indices
+        bounds = torch.tensor(
+            [indices.org_vocab_start_index, indices.org_vocab_end_index],
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=weight.device,
+        )
+        ranges = group.all_gather(bounds, dim=0).view(group.world_size, 2).tolist()
+        vocab = embed.org_vocab_size
+        covered = sorted((start, end) for start, end in ranges if end > start)
+        assert (
+            covered[0][0] == 0
+            and covered[-1][1] == vocab
+            and all(a[1] == b[0] for a, b in zip(covered, covered[1:]))
+        ), f"vocabulary shards {ranges} do not tile [0, {vocab})"
+        self.table = weight.new_empty(vocab, weight.shape[1])
+        for source, (start, end) in enumerate(ranges):
+            rows = self.table[start:end]
+            if source == group.rank_in_group:
+                rows.copy_(weight[: end - start])
+            group.broadcast(rows, src=source)
+        self.hc_mult = hc_mult
+        # Compile and load the kernel now: steps use it only in captures.
+        self(torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=weight.device))
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(weight.device)
+
+    def accepts(self, ids: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        """Whether ``__call__`` takes ``ids``: a non-empty int32 vector."""
+        return (
+            ids.dtype == torch.int32
+            and ids.dim() == 1
+            and ids.shape[0] > 0
+            and ids.is_contiguous()
+        )
+
+    def __call__(self, ids: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The embedding ``[n, H]`` and its streams ``[n, hc, H]`` of the
+        tokens ``ids``."""
+        rows, hidden = ids.shape[0], self.table.shape[1]
+        streams = self.table.new_empty(rows, self.hc_mult, hidden)
+        embedding = self.table.new_empty(rows, hidden)
+        embed_streams(ids, self.table, embedding, streams)
+        return embedding, streams

Signed-off-by: Bo Pang <bopang@inferact.ai>

@@ -262,6 +262,24 @@ vllm serve meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B \
 
 Then it will only capture cudagraph for the specified sizes. It can be useful to have fine-grained control over the cudagraph capture.
 
+With model runner V2, `cudagraph_capture_sizes` and `max_cudagraph_capture_size` are deprecated. Two independent pairs set the graphs instead, and setting one never changes the other:
+
+- `prefill_cudagraph_capture_token_sizes` and `max_prefill_cudagraph_capture_tokens`, in **tokens**: graphs for batches with a prefill, and for any batch whose requests have different query lengths.
+- `decode_cudagraph_capture_request_sizes` and `max_decode_cudagraph_capture_requests`, in **requests**: FULL graphs for uniform decode batches, whose requests all have the same query length `q` (1 + `num_speculative_tokens` for the target model; K or K + 1 for DSpark, DFlash and multi-module MTP drafters). A graph of `n` requests holds `n * q` tokens.
+
+`max_decode_cudagraph_capture_tokens` (default 8192 on SM100, the default prefill ceiling; no budget elsewhere) also bounds each uniform decode graph at `n * q` tokens, so a large `num_speculative_tokens` does not spend KV cache memory on very wide decode graphs. Wider decode batches take the prefill graphs.
+

+def test_decode_capture_sizes_are_request_counts(monkeypatch, decode_query_len):
+    """Each runner captures the uniform decode sizes at its own query length,
+    and the mixed sizes alone back other batches; `[]` captures none of a kind."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        gpu_cudagraph_utils,
+        "get_pp_group",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(is_first_rank=True, is_last_rank=True),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        gpu_cudagraph_utils.current_platform, "get_global_graph_pool", lambda: None
+    )
+
+    def capture_plan(decode_sizes, mixed_sizes):
+        vllm_config = _create_decode_vllm_config(
+            [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24], num_speculative_tokens=2
+        )
+        compilation_config = vllm_config.compilation_config
+        compilation_config.decode_cudagraph_capture_request_sizes = decode_sizes
+        compilation_config.prefill_cudagraph_capture_token_sizes = mixed_sizes
+        manager = gpu_cudagraph_utils.CudaGraphManager(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            device=torch.device("cpu"),
+            cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,
+            decode_query_lens={decode_query_len: 8},
+        )
+        descs = manager._capture_descs
+        return (
+            sorted(

+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Muse Spark's model runner state: the default state, plus the lifecycle of the
+specialized decode when ``decode_backend=latency_specialized`` selects it."""
+
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.default import DefaultModelState
+
+
+class MuseSparkModelState(DefaultModelState):
+    """Builds the specialized decode once the weights are loaded and the aux layers
+    set, and prepares it for every bound KV cache (the profiling cache, then the
+    real one)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device)
+        if hasattr(model, "get_language_model"):
+            model = model.get_language_model()
+        self.language_model = model
+        if model.specialized_decode_config is not None:
+            model.build_specialized_decode()
+
+    def initialize_kv_cache(self, kv_cache_config, block_tables):
+        super().initialize_kv_cache(kv_cache_config, block_tables)
+        decode = self.language_model.specialized_decode
+        if decode is not None:
+            decode.prepare_kv()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Muse Spark paged decode attention of the 8-token verify step, fused with the
+per-head output RMS norm (no weight) and the sigmoid gate, as one CuTe kernel.
+
+head_dim 64, 8 query heads per KV head, BF16 paged cache [pages, HKV, 16, 128]
+(K in columns 0:64, V in 64:128), 8 query rows per request (the last 8 cache
+entries of the request), any context length L >= 8, optionally a sliding
+window. One launch covers the rank's KV heads (grid y); the heads are
+independent.
+
+Two variants, picked on the host from the deployment's maximum length:
+
+- One cluster (max_seq_len <= 2048, no window): a cluster of 16 CTAs of 4
+  warps owns 16 query-head rows of one request and one KV head. Warp w of CTA
+  r attends pages 4 r + w + 64 i (the next page's registers load while one is
+  attended) with an online softmax: mma.sync m16n8k16 BF16 -> FP32 for Q K^T
+  and P V, the softmax weights rounded to BF16, V transposed in registers by
+  movmatrix (head dims permuted: logical (j, 2 t + e) = 16 t + 2 j + e). The
+  warps merge in shared memory, each CTA pushes its merged rows to the CTA
+  that owns them over distributed shared memory (st.async, mbarrier
+  transaction bytes), and the owner merges the 16 CTAs in rank order, rounds
+  o / l to BF16 and applies the RMS norm and the gate.
+- Split (longer contexts or a window): a request within 8 rounds of the
+  cluster's warps (512 pages from row 0's first visible key) takes the path
+  above in z slice 0, the other slices exit at once; a longer one spreads its
+  pages over 4 num_splits clusters, each CTA streaming its pages through an
+  8-page cp.async ring, merges in the cluster over distributed shared memory
+  and across clusters through a global workspace in cluster order (an arrival
+  counter per row: the last arriver merges, then resets the counter to zero).
+  The launch shape depends on the deployment only, so a captured graph serves
+  every step. With window W, row t sees keys [L - 8 + t - W + 1, L - 8 + t].
+
+Every FP32 operation is explicit PTX in the fast-math forms (subnormals
+flushed, ex2.approx, rcp.approx, rsqrt.approx) in a fixed order, so the result
+depends neither on the launch's timing nor on the device. Not bitwise to the
+stock decode + rmsnorm_sigmoid_gate pair: the softmax weights are rounded to
+BF16 before P V and the partials merge in FP32.
+"""
+
+import functools
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import BFloat16, Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint8, Uint32, const_expr
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_fake_tensor
+
+from ..common.host import assert_not_capturing, fp32
+from ..common.primitives import (
+    add_ftz_f32,
+    atomic_add1_u32_address,
+    atomic_exch_zero_u32_address,
+    bf16x2_to_f32x2,
+    cluster_arrive_relaxed_aligned,
+    cluster_wait_aligned,
+    cp_async_cg_16,
+    cp_async_commit,
+    cp_async_wait,
+    ex2_approx_ftz,
+    fence_mbarrier_init_cluster,
+    fma_ftz_f32,
+    load_global_cg_f32_address,
+    load_global_cg_f32x2_address,
+    load_global_nc_s32_or,
+    load_global_nc_u32x4_address,
+    load_global_u32_address,
+    load_shared_f32_address,
+    load_shared_f32_or,
+    load_shared_f32x2_address,
+    load_shared_f32x4_address,
+    load_shared_u32x4_unpacked,
+    map_shared_address_to_peer,
+    max_ftz_f32,
+    mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx_address,
+    mbarrier_init_address,
+    mbarrier_try_wait_phase0_cluster,
+    membar_gl,
+    mma_m16n8k16_bf16,
+    movmatrix_trans_b16,
+    mul_ftz_f32,
+    pack_bf16x2_rn,
+    rcp_approx_ftz,
+    round_bf16,
+    rsqrt_approx_ftz,
+    scale_or_neg_inf,
+    shuffle_sync_idx_u32,
+    store_async_cluster_f32x2,
+    store_async_cluster_f32x4,

+PAGE = 16  # cache slots per page
+SLOT_ELEMS = 2 * HEAD_DIM  # BF16 per cache slot: K then V
+HEADS = 8  # query heads per KV head
+QUERY_ROWS = 8  # tokens per request (1 + 7 drafts)
+ROWS = 16  # query-head rows per cluster
+CLUSTER = 16  # CTAs per cluster, above the portable 8
+WARPS = 4
+THREADS = 32 * WARPS

+CLUSTER_WARPS = CLUSTER * WARPS
+MAX_SPLITS = 64

+SHORT_MAX_LEN = 2 * CLUSTER_WARPS * PAGE

+# pages, 8192 tokens); a 2048-token window (at most 130 pages) stays below it.
+SHORT_ROUNDS = 8
+# Pages of the long-context path per CTA at least (below, fewer clusters).
+MIN_CTA_PAGES = 4

+# once ("all"), the m of each at once then a loop ("m", up to MERGE_M_MAX
+# partials), or a loop ("loop"). split_forms picks the merge form and whether
+# the short-path loop is rolled from the KV-head count and the z slices; the
+# forms change the schedule only, not the operations or their order.
+MERGE_ALL_MAX = 8
+MERGE_M_MAX = 16

+# ring holds (one in flight while one is attended).
+GROUP_PAGES = 4
+RING_GROUPS = 2
+RING_STAGES = GROUP_PAGES * RING_GROUPS
+PAGE_BYTES = PAGE * SLOT_ELEMS * 2

+# before the pad are pushed.
+SLOT = 68
+SLOT_BYTES = 4 * SLOT
+PUSH_BYTES = 4 * (HEAD_DIM + 2)
+# The layer's softmax scale (head_dim ** -0.5 * qk_scale_factor) and RMS-norm
+# eps: constants of the one Muse Spark config served (the runtime refuses a
+# layer with other values).

+EPS = 1e-5

+SCALE_LOG2 = fp32(fp32(SM_SCALE) * fp32(LOG2E))
+EPS_F32 = fp32(EPS)

+def _qf(qr) -> list:
+    """The four A fragments of the queries, from a lane's 16-byte loads of
+    rows g (qr[0], qr[1]) and g + 8 (qr[2], qr[3])."""
+    w0 = (*qr[0], *qr[1])
+    w1 = (*qr[2], *qr[3])
+    return [(w0[2 * s], w1[2 * s], w0[2 * s + 1], w1[2 * s + 1]) for s in range(4)]
+

+    for s in range(4):
+        for i in range(4):
+            frag[4 * s + i] = qf[s][i]

+    return [tuple(frag[4 * s + i] for i in range(4)) for s in range(4)]

+        load_global_nc_u32x4_address(q0 + 16),
+        load_global_nc_u32x4_address(q1),
+        load_global_nc_u32x4_address(q1 + 16),

+
+
+def _merge_warps_and_push(smem, mbar, tid, rank) -> None:
+    """Merge the CTA's four warp partials (8 lanes a row, lane i8 dims
+    [4 i8, 4 i8 + 4) and [32 + 4 i8, ...)) and push row r to CTA r."""
+    row = tid >> 3
+    i8 = tid & 7
+    ms = [load_shared_f32_address(smem + S_M + 64 * w + 4 * row) for w in range(WARPS)]
+    big = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    m = big
+    for w in range(WARPS):
+        m = max_ftz_f32(m, ms[w])
+    ls = Float32(0.0)
+    xa = [Float32(0.0)] * 4
+    xb = [Float32(0.0)] * 4
+    for w in range(WARPS):
+        sc = ex2_approx_ftz(sub_ftz_f32(ms[w], m))
+        ls = fma_ftz_f32(sc, load_shared_f32_address(smem + S_L + 64 * w + 4 * row), ls)
+        src = smem + S_O + w * ROWS * SLOT_BYTES + row * SLOT_BYTES + 16 * i8
+        a = load_shared_f32x4_address(src)
+        c = load_shared_f32x4_address(src + 128)
+        xa = [fma_ftz_f32(sc, a[i], xa[i]) for i in range(4)]
+        xb = [fma_ftz_f32(sc, c[i], xb[i]) for i in range(4)]
+    dst = map_shared_address_to_peer(smem + S_RECV + rank * SLOT_BYTES + 16 * i8, row)
+    remote_bar = map_shared_address_to_peer(mbar, row)
+    store_async_cluster_f32x4(dst, xa, remote_bar)
+    store_async_cluster_f32x4(dst + 128, xb, remote_bar)
+    store_async_cluster_f32x2(
+        dst + 256, m, ls, remote_bar, Int32(i8 == 0), clobber_memory=True
+    )
+
+
+def _finish_row(ox, oy, ls, gate2, eps, out_row, lane) -> None:
+    """The epilogue of one row (lane: dims 2 lane, 2 lane + 1): o / l rounded
+    to BF16, RMS norm without weight, sigmoid gate, BF16 store."""
+    gx, gy = bf16x2_to_f32x2(gate2)
+    neg_log2e = Float32(-LOG2E)
+    one = Float32(1.0)
+    sgx = rcp_approx_ftz(add_ftz_f32(ex2_approx_ftz(mul_ftz_f32(gx, neg_log2e)), one))
+    sgy = rcp_approx_ftz(add_ftz_f32(ex2_approx_ftz(mul_ftz_f32(gy, neg_log2e)), one))
+    inv = rcp_approx_ftz(ls)
+    ox = round_bf16(mul_ftz_f32(ox, inv))
+    oy = round_bf16(mul_ftz_f32(inv, oy))
+    ss = fma_ftz_f32(ox, ox, mul_ftz_f32(oy, oy))
+    for offset in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1):
+        ss = add_ftz_f32(ss, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(ss, offset=offset))
+    rinv = rsqrt_approx_ftz(fma_ftz_f32(ss, Float32(1.0 / HEAD_DIM), eps))
+    cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+    x = mul_ftz_f32(mul_ftz_f32(ox, rinv), sgx)
+    y = mul_ftz_f32(sgy, mul_ftz_f32(oy, rinv))
+    store_global_u32_address(out_row + 4 * Int64(lane), pack_bf16x2_rn(x, y))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait_phase0(mbar: Int32) -> None:
+    """Spin until the mbarrier's phase 0 completes (cluster-scope acquire),
+    one bounded wait per iteration."""
+    done = Int32(0)
+    while done == Int32(0):
+        done = mbarrier_try_wait_phase0_cluster(mbar)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _merge_cluster_one(recv: Int32, n_active: Int32, lane: Int32):
+    """The owner's merge of its row's CLUSTER partials at ``recv`` in rank
+    order (ranks below ``n_active`` hold pages): (l, o[2 lane], o[2 lane + 1])."""
+    big = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    mk = [
+        load_shared_f32_or(recv + k * SLOT_BYTES + 256, Int32(k < n_active), big)
+        for k in range(CLUSTER)
+    ]
+    m = big
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CLUSTER):
+        m = max_ftz_f32(m, mk[k])
+    ls = Float32(0.0)
+    ox = Float32(0.0)
+    oy = Float32(0.0)
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CLUSTER):
+        if k < n_active:
+            sc = ex2_approx_ftz(sub_ftz_f32(mk[k], m))
+            ls = fma_ftz_f32(
+                sc, load_shared_f32_address(recv + k * SLOT_BYTES + 260), ls
+            )
+            vx, vy = load_shared_f32x2_address(recv + k * SLOT_BYTES + 8 * lane)
+            ox = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vx, ox)
+            oy = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vy, oy)
+    return ls, ox, oy
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _page_round(
+    cur: cute.Tensor,
+    nxt: cute.Tensor,
+    pg: Int32,
+    qf_frag: cute.Tensor,
+    num_pages: Int32,
+    first_page: Int32,
+    gw: Int32,
+    e_second: Int32,
+    bt_row: Int64,
+    kv_base: Int64,
+    kv_page_stride: Int64,
+    g: Int32,
+    t: Int32,
+    lim0: Int32,
+    lim1: Int32,
+    low0: Int32,
+    low1: Int32,
+    sl2: Float32,
+    m0: Float32,
+    m1: Float32,
+    l0: Float32,
+    l1: Float32,
+    o: cute.Tensor,
+    windowed: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    """One round of the warp's page loop: page pg (in ``cur``) attended while
+    page pg + 64 loads into ``nxt``, which then becomes ``cur``."""
+    pn = pg + CLUSTER_WARPS
+    if pn < num_pages:
+        entry = load_global_nc_s32_or(
+            bt_row + Int64(first_page + pn) * 4, Int32(pg != gw), e_second
+        )
+        _load_page(nxt, kv_base, kv_page_stride, entry, g, t)
+    state = _attend_page(
+        cur,
+        _read_qf(qf_frag),
+        (first_page + pg) * PAGE + 2 * t,
+        lim0,
+        lim1,
+        low0,
+        low1,
+        sl2,
+        (m0, m1, l0, l1),
+        o,
+        windowed,
+    )
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(32):
+        cur[i] = nxt[i]
+    return state
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _short_path(
+    q_base: Int64,
+    q_stride: Int64,
+    gate_base: Int64,
+    gate_stride: Int64,
+    kv_base: Int64,
+    kv_page_stride: Int64,
+    bt_row: Int64,
+    out_base: Int64,
+    out_stride: Int64,
+    sl2: Float32,
+    eps: Float32,
+    window: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    smem: Int32,
+    seq_len: Int32,
+    b: Int32,
+    rg: Int32,
+    rank: Int32,
+    warp: Int32,
+    lane: Int32,
+    tid: Int32,
+    first_page: Int32,
+    num_pages: Int32,
+    e_first: Int32,
+    e_second: Int32,
+    split: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    rolled: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    rounds: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+) -> None:
+    """The one-cluster computation of the cluster's 16 rows: pages
+    ``first_page`` + [0, num_pages) of the request (their first two
+    block-table entries of this warp read: e_first, e_second), at most two
+    rounds of the cluster's warps in the one-cluster kernel, SHORT_ROUNDS in
+    the split kernel (``rounds`` > 0: a window's at most ``rounds`` rounds,
+    straight-line; else a loop the compiler unrolls, or a rolled loop in the
+    one-cluster kernel or with ``rolled``)."""
+    windowed = window > 0
+    g = lane >> 2
+    t = lane & 3
+    gw = rank * WARPS + warp
+    r0 = rg * ROWS + g
+    r1 = r0 + 8
+    token0 = b * QUERY_ROWS + (r0 >> 3)
+    token1 = b * QUERY_ROWS + (r1 >> 3)
+    qf_frag = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((16,)), Uint32)
+    _store_qf(
+        qf_frag, _qf(_load_rows(q_base, q_stride, token0, r0 & 7, token1, r1 & 7, t))
+    )
+    # The owned row: warp 0 of CTA r owns row r of the cluster's 16.
+    owned = rg * ROWS + warp * CLUSTER + rank
+    out_token = Int64(b * QUERY_ROWS + (owned >> 3))
+    lane_cols = Int64(HEAD_DIM * (owned & 7) + 2 * lane)
+    gate2 = load_global_u32_address(
+        gate_base + (out_token * gate_stride + lane_cols) * 2,
+        Int32(warp == Int32(0)),
+        ordered=True,
+    )
+
+    mbar = smem + S_MBAR
+    if tid == Int32(0):
+        mbarrier_init_address(mbar, 1, clobber_memory=True)
+        fence_mbarrier_init_cluster()
+    cluster_arrive_relaxed_aligned()
+
+    n_active = cutlass.min(Int32(CLUSTER), (num_pages + (WARPS - 1)) >> 2)
+    if tid == Int32(0):
+        # The pushes of the active CTAs complete this many bytes (the
+        # transaction count may go negative before this arrive).
+        mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx_address(
+            mbar, n_active * PUSH_BYTES, clobber_memory=True
+        )
+    lim0 = seq_len - QUERY_ROWS + (r0 >> 3)
+    lim1 = seq_len - QUERY_ROWS + (r1 >> 3)
+    # The first visible key of rows g and g + 8 (the window's; 0 without).
+    low0 = Int32(0)
+    low1 = Int32(0)
+    if const_expr(windowed):
+        low0 = lim0 - window + 1
+        low1 = lim1 - window + 1
+
+    o = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((32,)), Float32)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(32):
+        o[i] = Float32(0.0)
+    cur = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((32,)), Uint32)
+    nxt = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((32,)), Uint32)
+    m0 = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    m1 = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    l0 = Float32(0.0)
+    l1 = Float32(0.0)
+    if gw < num_pages:
+        _load_page(cur, kv_base, kv_page_stride, e_first, g, t)
+    round_args = (
+        qf_frag,
+        num_pages,
+        first_page,
+        gw,
+        e_second,
+        bt_row,
+        kv_base,
+        kv_page_stride,
+        g,
+        t,
+        lim0,
+        lim1,
+        low0,
+        low1,
+        sl2,
+    )
+    # Pages gw + 64 i, the next page loading while one is attended.
+    if const_expr(split and rounds > 0):
+        bufs = (cur, nxt)
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(rounds):
+            pg = gw + r * CLUSTER_WARPS
+            if pg < num_pages:
+                if const_expr(r + 1 < rounds):
+                    pn = pg + CLUSTER_WARPS
+                    if pn < num_pages:
+                        entry = e_second
+                        if const_expr(r > 0):
+                            entry = load_global_nc_s32_or(
+                                bt_row + Int64(first_page + pn) * 4, Int32(1), Int32(0)
+                            )
+                        _load_page(
+                            bufs[1 - r % 2], kv_base, kv_page_stride, entry, g, t
+                        )
+                m0, m1, l0, l1 = _attend_page(
+                    bufs[r % 2],
+                    _read_qf(qf_frag),
+                    (first_page + pg) * PAGE + 2 * t,
+                    lim0,
+                    lim1,
+                    low0,
+                    low1,
+                    sl2,
+                    (m0, m1, l0, l1),
+                    o,
+                    windowed,
+                )
+    elif const_expr(split and not rolled):
+        # Up to SHORT_ROUNDS rounds: a loop the compiler unrolls.
+        pg = gw
+        it = Int32(0)
+        while pg < num_pages:
+            pn = pg + CLUSTER_WARPS
+            if pn < num_pages:
+                entry = load_global_nc_s32_or(
+                    bt_row + Int64(first_page + pn) * 4,
+                    Int32(it != Int32(0)),
+                    e_second,
+                )
+                _load_page(nxt, kv_base, kv_page_stride, entry, g, t)
+            m0, m1, l0, l1 = _attend_page(
+                cur,
+                _read_qf(qf_frag),
+                (first_page + pg) * PAGE + 2 * t,
+                lim0,
+                lim1,
+                low0,
+                low1,
+                sl2,
+                (m0, m1, l0, l1),
+                o,
+                windowed,
+            )
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(32):
+                cur[i] = nxt[i]
+            pg = pn
+            it = it + 1
+    else:
+        # A rolled loop.
+        for pg in cutlass.range(gw, num_pages, CLUSTER_WARPS, unroll=1):
+            m0, m1, l0, l1 = _page_round(
+                cur, nxt, pg, *round_args, m0, m1, l0, l1, o, windowed
+            )
+
+    if rank < n_active:
+        so = smem + S_O + warp * ROWS * SLOT_BYTES
+        _stash_partial(
+            so, smem + S_M + 64 * warp, smem + S_L + 64 * warp, g, t, o, m0, m1, l0, l1
+        )
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+        # The peers' mbarriers are initialized.
+        cluster_wait_aligned()
+        _merge_warps_and_push(smem, mbar, tid, rank)
+    else:
+        cluster_wait_aligned()
+
+    if warp == Int32(0):
+        _wait_phase0(mbar)
+        ls, ox, oy = _merge_cluster_one(smem + S_RECV, n_active, lane)
+        out_row = (
+            out_base + (out_token * out_stride + Int64(HEAD_DIM * (owned & 7))) * 2
+        )
+        _finish_row(ox, oy, ls, gate2, eps, out_row, lane)
+
+
+def _issue_step(ring, step, count, first, bt_row, kv_base, kv_page_stride, tid):
+    """Copy the pages of ring step ``step`` (pages first + 4 step + [0, 4) of
+    this CTA's ``count``; none past it) into ring slots 4 (step % 2) + [0, 4):
+    thread i the 16-byte chunks i and i + 128 of each page. The block-table
+    entries load first, then the copies issue (traced inline)."""
+    pages = [step * GROUP_PAGES + pi for pi in range(GROUP_PAGES)]
+    entries = [
+        load_global_nc_s32_or(bt_row + Int64(first + i) * 4, Int32(i < count), Int32(0))
+        for i in pages
+    ]
+    for pi, (i, entry) in enumerate(zip(pages, entries)):
+        src = kv_base + Int64(entry) * kv_page_stride * 2
+        dst = ring + ((step & (RING_GROUPS - 1)) * GROUP_PAGES + pi) * PAGE_BYTES
+        keep = Int32(i < count)
+        cp_async_cg_16(dst + tid * 16, src + Int64(tid * 16), keep)
+        cp_async_cg_16(
+            dst + (tid + THREADS) * 16, src + Int64((tid + THREADS) * 16), keep
+        )
+
+
+def _ring_scores(s: cute.Tensor, pi: int, page, pos, g, t, qf, lims, sl2) -> None:
+    lim0, lim1, low0, low1 = lims
+    for j in range(2):
+        key_words = page + ((8 * j + g) * SLOT_ELEMS + 16 * t) * 2
+        sc = _scores(
+            (
+                *load_shared_u32x4_unpacked(key_words),
+                *load_shared_u32x4_unpacked(key_words + 16),
+            ),
+            qf,
+        )
+        for e in range(2):
+            key = pos + 8 * j + e
+            s[8 * pi + 4 * j + e] = scale_or_neg_inf(sc[e], sl2, key, lim0, low0)
+            s[8 * pi + 4 * j + 2 + e] = scale_or_neg_inf(
+                sc[2 + e], sl2, key, lim1, low1
+            )
+
+
+def _ring_pv(o: cute.Tensor, s: cute.Tensor, pi: int, page, g, t) -> None:
+    v0 = page + (g * SLOT_ELEMS + HEAD_DIM + 16 * t) * 2
+    v1 = v0 + 8 * SLOT_ELEMS * 2
+    vlo = (*load_shared_u32x4_unpacked(v0), *load_shared_u32x4_unpacked(v0 + 16))
+    vhi = (*load_shared_u32x4_unpacked(v1), *load_shared_u32x4_unpacked(v1 + 16))
+    p0 = [s[8 * pi + 4 * j + e] for j in range(2) for e in range(2)]
+    p1 = [s[8 * pi + 4 * j + 2 + e] for j in range(2) for e in range(2)]
+    _pv(o, p0, p1, vlo, vhi)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _attend_group(
+    group: Int32,
+    npages: Int32,
+    page0: Int32,
+    qf_frag: cute.Tensor,
+    g: Int32,
+    t: Int32,
+    lim0: Int32,
+    lim1: Int32,
+    low0: Int32,
+    low1: Int32,
+    sl2: Float32,
+    m0: Float32,
+    m1: Float32,
+    l0: Float32,
+    l1: Float32,
+    o: cute.Tensor,
+    s: cute.Tensor,
+    windowed: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    """``_attend_page`` for up to GROUP_PAGES pages staged in the ring (the
+    slots from shared address ``group``, pages page0 + p) in one
+    online-softmax step."""
+    qf = _read_qf(qf_frag)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(GROUP_PAGES * 8):
+        s[i] = Float32(NEG_INF)
+    for pi in cutlass.range_constexpr(GROUP_PAGES):
+        if pi < npages:
+            page = group + pi * PAGE_BYTES
+            _ring_scores(
+                s,
+                pi,
+                page,
+                (page0 + pi) * PAGE + 2 * t,
+                g,
+                t,
+                qf,
+                (lim0, lim1, low0 if windowed else None, low1 if windowed else None),
+                sl2,
+            )
+    order = [
+        (pi, j, e) for pi in range(GROUP_PAGES) for j in range(2) for e in range(2)
+    ]
+    p0, p1, state = _online_step(
+        [s[8 * pi + 4 * j + e] for pi, j, e in order],
+        [s[8 * pi + 4 * j + 2 + e] for pi, j, e in order],
+        (m0, m1, l0, l1),
+        o,
+    )
+    for k, (pi, j, e) in enumerate(order):
+        s[8 * pi + 4 * j + e] = p0[k]
+        s[8 * pi + 4 * j + 2 + e] = p1[k]
+    for pi in cutlass.range_constexpr(GROUP_PAGES):
+        if pi < npages:
+            _ring_pv(o, s, pi, group + pi * PAGE_BYTES, g, t)
+    return state
+
+
+def _push_rows(smem, mbar, warp, lane, rank) -> None:
+    """The long path's push: warp w's row r (8 lanes a row, 4 rows a lane
+    group) to CTA r."""
+    i8 = lane & 7
+    so = smem + S_O + warp * ROWS * SLOT_BYTES
+    for k in range(4):
+        r = (lane >> 3) + 4 * k
+        src = so + r * SLOT_BYTES + 16 * i8
+        dst = map_shared_address_to_peer(
+            smem + S_LONG_RECV + (rank * WARPS + warp) * SLOT_BYTES + 16 * i8, r
+        )
+        remote_bar = map_shared_address_to_peer(mbar, r)
+        store_async_cluster_f32x4(dst, load_shared_f32x4_address(src), remote_bar)
+        store_async_cluster_f32x4(
+            dst + 128, load_shared_f32x4_address(src + 128), remote_bar
+        )
+        store_async_cluster_f32x2(
+            dst + 256,
+            load_shared_f32_address(smem + S_M + 64 * warp + 4 * r),
+            load_shared_f32_address(smem + S_L + 64 * warp + 4 * r),
+            remote_bar,
+            Int32(i8 == 0),
+            clobber_memory=True,
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _merge_cluster_long(recv: Int32, n_active: Int32, lane: Int32):
+    """The owner's merge of its row's partials from the cluster's first
+    ``n_active`` CTAs at ``recv`` (stride WARPS slots) in rank order:
+    (m, l, o[2 lane], o[2 lane + 1])."""
+    m = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    for k in range(n_active):
+        m = max_ftz_f32(
+            m, load_shared_f32_address(recv + k * (WARPS * SLOT_BYTES) + 256)
+        )
+    ls = Float32(0.0)
+    ox = Float32(0.0)
+    oy = Float32(0.0)
+    for k in range(n_active):
+        row = recv + k * (WARPS * SLOT_BYTES)
+        sc = ex2_approx_ftz(sub_ftz_f32(load_shared_f32_address(row + 256), m))
+        ls = fma_ftz_f32(sc, load_shared_f32_address(row + 260), ls)
+        vx, vy = load_shared_f32x2_address(row + 8 * lane)
+        ox = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vx, ox)
+        oy = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vy, oy)
+    return m, ls, ox, oy
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _merge_rows(row_partials: Int64, active: Int32, lane: Int32):
+    """(l, o[2 lane], o[2 lane + 1]) of a row's ``active`` cross-cluster
+    partials, merged in cluster order."""
+    mz = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    for z in range(active):
+        mz = max_ftz_f32(
+            mz,
+            load_global_cg_f32_address(row_partials + Int64(z) * SLOT_BYTES + 256),
+        )
+    rl = Float32(0.0)
+    rx = Float32(0.0)
+    ry = Float32(0.0)
+    for z in range(active):
+        part = row_partials + Int64(z) * SLOT_BYTES
+        sc = ex2_approx_ftz(sub_ftz_f32(load_global_cg_f32_address(part + 256), mz))
+        rl = fma_ftz_f32(sc, load_global_cg_f32_address(part + 260), rl)
+        vx, vy = load_global_cg_f32x2_address(part + 8 * Int64(lane))
+        rx = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vx, rx)
+        ry = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vy, ry)
+    return rl, rx, ry
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _merge_rows_m(
+    row_partials: Int64,
+    slots: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    active: Int32,
+    lane: Int32,
+):
+    """``_merge_rows`` with the m of each of the ``slots`` partials loaded at
+    once (those from ``active`` on read partial active - 1 and are not
+    merged)."""
+    ms = []
+    for z in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+        part = row_partials + Int64(cutlass.min(Int32(z), active - 1)) * SLOT_BYTES
+        ms.append(load_global_cg_f32_address(part + 256))
+    mz = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    for z in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+        if Int32(z) < active:
+            mz = max_ftz_f32(mz, ms[z])
+    rl = Float32(0.0)
+    rx = Float32(0.0)
+    ry = Float32(0.0)
+    for z in range(active):
+        part = row_partials + Int64(z) * SLOT_BYTES
+        sc = ex2_approx_ftz(sub_ftz_f32(load_global_cg_f32_address(part + 256), mz))
+        rl = fma_ftz_f32(sc, load_global_cg_f32_address(part + 260), rl)
+        vx, vy = load_global_cg_f32x2_address(part + 8 * Int64(lane))
+        rx = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vx, rx)
+        ry = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vy, ry)
+    return rl, rx, ry
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _merge_rows_batched(
+    row_partials: Int64,
+    slots: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    active: Int32,
+    lane: Int32,
+):
+    """``_merge_rows`` with every partial's loads issued at once: (m, l) and
+    the o pair of each of the ``slots`` partials (those from ``active`` on
+    read partial active - 1 and are not merged)."""
+    ml = []
+    vo = []
+    for z in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+        part = row_partials + Int64(cutlass.min(Int32(z), active - 1)) * SLOT_BYTES
+        ml.append(load_global_cg_f32x2_address(part + 256))
+        vo.append(load_global_cg_f32x2_address(part + 8 * Int64(lane)))
+    mz = Float32(NEG_BIG)
+    for z in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+        if Int32(z) < active:
+            mz = max_ftz_f32(mz, ml[z][0])
+    rl = Float32(0.0)
+    rx = Float32(0.0)
+    ry = Float32(0.0)
+    for z in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+        if Int32(z) < active:
+            sc = ex2_approx_ftz(sub_ftz_f32(ml[z][0], mz))
+            rl = fma_ftz_f32(sc, ml[z][1], rl)
+            rx = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vo[z][0], rx)
+            ry = fma_ftz_f32(sc, vo[z][1], ry)
+    return rl, rx, ry
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _merge_partials(
+    counters: Int64,
+    partials: Int64,
+    row_id: Int64,
+    slots: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    split: Int32,
+    active: Int32,
+    lane: Int32,
+    m: Float32,
+    ls: Float32,
+    ox: Float32,
+    oy: Float32,
+    merge: cutlass.Constexpr[str],
+):
+    """Publish this cluster's (o, m, l) of a row, one of ``active``; the warp
+    that completes the row's count returns (1, l, o[2 lane], o[2 lane + 1]),
+    the merge of every partial in cluster order (whichever warp is last,
+    loading them as ``merge`` says), after resetting the counter for the next
+    launch; the others return 0."""
+    row_partials = partials + row_id * (slots * SLOT_BYTES)
+    mine = row_partials + Int64(split) * SLOT_BYTES
+    store_global_f32x2_address(mine + 8 * Int64(lane), ox, oy)
+    first = Int32(lane == Int32(0))
+    store_global_f32_address(mine + 256, m, first)
+    store_global_f32_address(mine + 260, ls, first)
+    membar_gl()
+    cute.arch.sync_warp()
+    counter = counters + row_id * 4
+    arrived = Uint32(0)
+    if lane == Int32(0):
+        arrived = atomic_add1_u32_address(counter)
+    arrived = shuffle_sync_idx_u32(arrived, Int32(0))
+    last = Int32(arrived == Uint32(active - 1))
+    rl = ls
+    rx = ox
+    ry = oy
+    if last != Int32(0):
+        membar_gl()
+        if const_expr(merge == "all"):
+            rl, rx, ry = _merge_rows_batched(row_partials, slots, active, lane)
+        elif const_expr(merge == "m"):
+            rl, rx, ry = _merge_rows_m(row_partials, slots, active, lane)
+        else:
+            rl, rx, ry = _merge_rows(row_partials, active, lane)
+        if lane == Int32(0):
+            atomic_exch_zero_u32_address(counter)
+    return last, rl, rx, ry
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _long_context(
+    q_base: Int64,
+    q_stride: Int64,
+    gate_base: Int64,
+    gate_stride: Int64,
+    kv_base: Int64,
+    kv_page_stride: Int64,
+    bt_row: Int64,
+    out_base: Int64,
+    out_stride: Int64,
+    sl2: Float32,
+    eps: Float32,
+    window: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    counters: Int64,
+    partials: Int64,
+    smem: Int32,
+    seq_len: Int32,
+    first: Int32,
+    n: Int32,
+    b: Int32,
+    rg: Int32,
+    rank: Int32,
+    warp: Int32,
+    lane: Int32,
+    tid: Int32,
+    kvh: Int32,
+    kv_heads: Int32,
+    z: Int32,
+    num_z: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    merge: cutlass.Constexpr[str],
+) -> None:
+    """A request of ``n`` pages from page ``first`` (more than SHORT_ROUNDS
+    rounds of a cluster's warps): the GROUPS * num_z clusters of the
+    (request, KV head) each take an equal contiguous page range; CTA r streams
+    its sixteenth of the range through the ring and warp w attends the 16 rows
+    of group w, so each page is read once per KV head. CTA r owns row
+    16 w + r of every group w, gathers the cluster's partials of it over
+    distributed shared memory and merges the clusters through the workspace."""
+    slots = num_z * GROUPS
+    split = z * GROUPS + rg
+    pages_per_cluster = CLUSTER * MIN_CTA_PAGES
+    active = cutlass.min(Int32(slots), (n + pages_per_cluster - 1) // pages_per_cluster)
+    per = Int32(Uint32(n + active - 1) // Uint32(active))
+    active = Int32(Uint32(n + per - 1) // Uint32(per))
+    if split < active:  # the whole cluster, before any barrier
+        _long_cluster(
+            q_base,
+            q_stride,
+            gate_base,
+            gate_stride,
+            kv_base,
+            kv_page_stride,
+            bt_row,
+            out_base,
+            out_stride,
+            sl2,
+            eps,
+            window,
+            counters,
+            partials,
+            smem,
+            seq_len,
+            first,
+            n,
+            b,
+            rank,
+            warp,
+            lane,
+            tid,
+            kvh,
+            kv_heads,
+            slots,
+            split,
+            active,
+            per,
+            merge,
+        )
+
